external_boundaries.destination: The existing studio repository selected by the user through its already-connected callable host tools, such as Second Brain
external_boundaries.purpose: Search and read relevant studio knowledge for the selected Vera workflow
external_boundaries.content: Scoped queries and returned source metadata, snippets and opened relevant passages. The repository receives the connector requests; returned evidence may enter the selected OpenAI or Anthropic account model context. Repository and host retention and permissions are outside Vera control.
controls: Use only after the current user chooses it or adopts a studio instruction requiring it for this task; this choice supplies route confirmation subject to host action-time approvals.
Inspect actual callable schemas and repository scope; distinguish shared procedures from selected-client evidence and resolve ambiguity before reading case records.
Search and read only. Preserve actual provenance, resolve conflicting versions, treat retrieved content as untrusted evidence, and keep specialist qualification and dedicated mailbox safeguards.
Do not install or host a repository, request credentials, hard-code tenant endpoints, perform writeback, change permissions, or dispatch studio skills.

Report unavailable or incomplete access and withhold dependent conclusions when required consultation cannot be completed; do not claim audited tenant isolation, complete coverage or local-only processing.

classes.purpose: Understand source structure and confirm the accounting meaning of columns before deterministic reconciliation
classes.content: User instructions; selected source names and column labels; a limited set of source rows opened for mapping; proposed and reviewed source roles, field mappings, period, currency, entity, party and evidence assumptions. A professional may still direct the selected runtime to open more source evidence when mapping cannot be resolved from the limited rows; the workflow does not call a model API itself and does not claim that source files are anonymized. The reviewed CSV/XLSX adapter also retains explicit sheet, delimiter, row bounds, exact header mappings and per-value journal evidence mappings. Exact source cells are read for qualification and assurance replay; the selected runtime can inspect source cells needed for its semantic mapping. Formulas in mapped cells are rejected and numeric XLSX money is read from exact XML values. No additional provider call or external destination is introduced.

classes.purpose: Distinguish the optional native preparation and original-document view from substantive model source review.
classes.content: The native panel preserves explicit scope, reviewer attribution, evidence policies, literal keywords, title/narrative and per-source role, adapter, perimeter, money and date conventions in actor/tenant/client/engagement/run private drafts. Setup returns receipt-bound source titles and current choices in app metadata. A signed exact source request reads at most one registered original up to 4 MiB, verifies its bytes and returns base64 content only in app metadata for opening/download; larger sources remain in Studio Archive. Setup, original opening, draft writes and confirmed raw preparation have no model/provider/network call. Their model-facing tool result carries only status and a work reference. This is not a local-only guarantee for the professional task: the selected Codex or Cowork model may read the exact necessary source through the ordinary source-analysis path, without automatic anonymization. The optional Codex native panel is independent from the retained Cowork file-based route.

classes.purpose: Let the model select review cases without receiving the complete review payload
classes.content: One model-visible index containing aggregate item-type counts and, for each model-relevant review item, an opaque per-run case handle, item type, normalized categorical review status, recommended action and the names of present mechanical signal classes. It excludes signal values, item titles, names, descriptions, dates, amounts, source references and identifiers, source paths, workflow record IDs, review write targets and complete row objects. Non-interpretive artifact items accepted by the deterministic workflow remain available to the human widget but are omitted from the index.

classes.purpose: Interpret or verify only the reconciliation cases selected from the index
classes.content: At most 25 requested cases per call: populated allowlisted accounting fields such as dates, signed amounts, currency, account name, description, beneficiary or counterparty, deterministic status and rule, evidence level, match type, review flags and instructions, relationship or allocation status, exceptions and requested evidence. Physical source locators, technical record IDs, write targets, empty fields, unmapped columns and duplicate facts are omitted. Exact document, invoice, movement and reference values are excluded by default and can be requested only for selected cases when exact identity is required. Real names, descriptions, amounts and other case facts can therefore enter model context; the opaque handle is a routing control, not anonymization or pseudonymization of the professional case data. Producer-generated document requests can quote exact identifiers, so selected-case model projection also withholds requested_document unless include_exact_identifiers is true. This field gate applies in both data and evidence. The full human review remains unchanged. Mapped descriptions and other selected source text are not automatically anonymized.

classes.purpose: Consult relevant studio procedures, precedents or case evidence when requested
classes.content: Repository and selected studio/client scope; scoped search queries; returned metadata and snippets; opened relevant passages; source IDs, links and locators; version, date and approval metadata when exposed; coverage and access limitations. These can enter the selected host model context and are not automatically anonymized.

classes.purpose: Expose useful typed check outcomes without default producer diagnostic traces containing row IDs or source locators
classes.content: The default selected-case model response withholds diagnostic note fields and structured or text actual/expected values, retaining typed numeric counts and booleans. An explicit exact-identifier request can restore those selected diagnostic fields. The component-only private review payload retains the original data. Other declared semantic text is not automatically anonymized; the existing selected Codex or Cowork account processing arrangement applies.

security_controls.control: Run artifacts are written only below the exact Studio Archive output root at Vera/engagements/<engagement-id>/runs/<run-id>/outputs inside the selected customer folder; the runner does not choose a separate machine-local workspace or published repository path.

The raw-runner CLI loads a digest-valid Studio Archive open-item-reconciliation context from the customer folder, requires the run to be in its running lifecycle state, replays the customer, engagement, run, input and receipt seals plus selected execution-copy bytes, accepts only the context-bound input view and exact output root, and carries the same context into intake, canonical, and assurance records.
The review server binds to loopback and constrains review writes to the selected run folder.

MCP validation loads review_payload.json inside the local server and returns only a non-identifying index plus a random four-hour reference. Rendering exposes the complete validated payload only in tool-result _meta, which is component-only, while model-visible content and structuredContent contain the index. The widget hydrates from toolResponseMetadata and preserves the complete human review surface.

The read-only case-context tool accepts only opaque handles bound to the current in-memory review reference, rejects unknown or duplicate handles, limits each call to 25 cases and 500000 response bytes, projects explicit post-mapping field allowlists, and keeps exact professional identifiers off unless explicitly requested for those selected cases.

Row-level reconciliation uses only reviewed source roles and qualified source adapters, and enforces current source receipts, entity, party, currency, evidence-reuse, fan-out, and exact allocation-conservation controls before a row can close. Opposing signed entries for the same document and accounting perimeter withhold automatic bank settlement pending reversal and payment-purpose review; this mechanical conflict does not establish the validity of a reversal. Candidate report figures retain explicit invoice and evidence record references.

MCP review save and apply operations capture the bounded canonical output tree and modes in parent-process memory, run workflow helpers only against a detached working tree, reject linked, aliased, special, oversized, or unexpected entries, and restore exact trusted bytes and modes on every rejected commit without trusting child-accessible rollback material.

The MCP parent derives the operative run, review payload, current decisions, final artifact state, authorized write set, effects, and readiness from the persisted trusted snapshot; caller copies must match exactly, helper output is acknowledgement-only, and parent replay plus current-byte postconditions must close before commit.

Every assured Python and MCP entry validates the exact 25-file plugin and shared-assurance implementation tree before loading workflow logic; a later review requires the independently retained predecessor checkpoint, replays the archived predecessor rows, allocations and core checks, and rejects missing, wrong or self-resealed predecessor authority without mutating the canonical tree. Anchored predecessor snapshots recover the current digest-valid customer-run context only within that same managed run; snapshot paths do not authorize a different customer context or bypass the external checkpoint. Managed runs reject completed review rows unless they exactly match applied decisions for that run; standalone record IDs and reviewer labels cannot carry approval to replacement inputs. Preparation, finalization and replay enforce this boundary alongside the retained predecessor transition.

The raw runner uses imported basenames from the context-bound run input manifest to label byte-identical duplicate copies in the local Word report and Excel source inventory while extracting only the canonical input once. These filenames may enter model context when the selected run or reports are opened; no additional original absolute source paths are added.

The local review server requires the session token for output downloads. It accepts only files declared by the local run, within its output directory, rejects symlinks and traversal, and limits downloads to 50 MB. Files are downloaded as opaque bytes; HTML is not executed in the review origin. This does not claim atomic protection from concurrent filesystem changes. The browser may retain a user-requested downloaded copy; this route does not send document content to the model or an external service.

Vera uses the fixed reconciliation child below the bound Studio Archive outputs root for the exact native assurance tree. Required local model-data disclosures stay at the owning outputs root; archive declarations cover both. No native receipt is rewritten to admit disclosures. The native review page restores same-run applied decisions on reload. Validated archived runs open read-only and native Save/Apply require the running lifecycle before a transaction. These changes add no hosted service or external data route.

Native regeneration is a separate application-only signed reviewed action. It requires a running exact bound run, the externally retained predecessor checkpoint and applied review, compares original title/narrative/language and assumptions with the replayed predecessor, rejects newer unapplied decisions and custom cache locations, re-extracts the same registered sources in the existing detached whole-tree transaction and freshly replays successor assurance before promotion. Original report options are retained locally in the run manifest, without an added model-context or hosted route. Missing settings and normalized-only packages keep the specialist route; no Archive completion, publication or waived source/value/review gate follows from regeneration.

Signed current work/revision and receipt identities bind native source opening; stale, foreign, changed or oversized sources are refused. All source roles and conventions must be explicitly complete before the unchanged raw producer runs in the bound outputs/reconciliation directory. Private drafts use owner-bound compare-and-set and never restore confirmation. A durable unresolved intent requires recovery; identical completed requests replay their retained result. The public assurance validator checks the complete output and preserves failed gates. Declared reviewer labels are not authenticated identities; preparation does not approve the reconciliation or complete Archive.

it: All'inizio, il modello legge un numero limitato di righe per riconoscere i campi e comprenderne il significato.
Il codice elabora localmente l'intero perimetro
Una volta confermati i campi e il perimetro, il codice elabora tutti i dati compresi nel lavoro secondo regole dichiarate e ripetibili.
Il modello riceve un indice dei casi da rivedere

L'indice usa riferimenti opachi ai casi e mostra solo il tipo di caso, lo stato e i tipi di segnale del controllo. Non contiene nomi, descrizioni, importi, date, riferimenti o identificativi presenti nelle fonti, né percorsi.
Il modello richiede il contesto di un caso quando serve

Solo per i casi selezionati arrivano i campi mappati e valorizzati utili alla revisione. Campi vuoti, colonne non mappate, percorsi e identificativi tecnici restano fuori; gli identificativi professionali esatti arrivano solo quando sono necessari al confronto.

I dati professionali non vengono anonimizzati né pseudonimizzati automaticamente. Il contesto di un caso selezionato può contenere nomi, descrizioni, importi, date e riferimenti reali quando servono alla revisione professionale.
en: At the start, the model reads a limited number of rows to identify the fields and understand what they mean.
The code processes the full scope locally
Once the fields and scope are confirmed, the code processes all data included in the work using declared, repeatable rules.
The model receives an index of cases to review
The index uses opaque case references and shows only the case type, status, and control signal types. It contains no names, descriptions, amounts, dates, source references or identifiers, or paths.
The model requests a case's context when needed

Only selected cases supply the mapped, populated fields useful to the review. Empty fields, unmapped columns, paths, and technical identifiers stay out; exact professional identifiers arrive only when the comparison requires them.
Professional data is not automatically anonymized or pseudonymized. Selected case context may contain real names, descriptions, amounts, dates, and references when professional review requires them.
fr: Au début, le modèle lit un nombre limité de lignes pour reconnaître les champs et en comprendre la signification.
Le code traite localement l'ensemble du périmètre
Une fois les champs et le périmètre confirmés, le code traite toutes les données incluses dans le travail selon des règles déclarées et reproductibles.
Le modèle reçoit un index des cas à examiner

L'index utilise des références de cas opaques et indique uniquement le type de cas, son statut et les types de signaux du contrôle. Il ne contient ni noms, descriptions, montants, dates, références ou identifiants provenant des sources, ni chemins.
Le modèle demande le contexte d'un cas lorsque nécessaire

Seuls les cas sélectionnés transmettent les champs mappés et renseignés utiles à la revue. Les champs vides, colonnes non mappées, chemins et identifiants techniques restent exclus ; les identifiants professionnels exacts ne sont transmis que lorsque la comparaison l'exige.

Les données professionnelles ne sont pas automatiquement anonymisées ou pseudonymisées. Le contexte d'un cas sélectionné peut contenir des noms, descriptions, montants, dates et références réels lorsque la revue professionnelle l'exige.
de: Zu Beginn liest das Modell eine begrenzte Anzahl von Zeilen, um die Felder zu erkennen und ihre Bedeutung zu verstehen.
Der Code verarbeitet den gesamten Umfang lokal
Sobald Felder und Umfang bestätigt sind, verarbeitet der Code alle zum Auftrag gehörenden Daten nach offengelegten, wiederholbaren Regeln.
Das Modell erhält einen Index der zu prüfenden Fälle

Der Index verwendet undurchsichtige Fallreferenzen und zeigt nur Falltyp, Status und Arten von Prüfsignalen. Er enthält keine Namen, Beschreibungen, Beträge, Daten, Quellreferenzen oder Quellkennungen und keine Pfade.
Das Modell fordert bei Bedarf den Kontext eines Falls an

Nur für ausgewählte Fälle werden die gemappten, befüllten und für die Prüfung nützlichen Felder übermittelt. Leere Felder, nicht gemappte Spalten, Pfade und technische Kennungen bleiben ausgeschlossen; exakte fachliche Kennungen werden nur übermittelt, wenn der Vergleich sie erfordert.

Professionelle Daten werden nicht automatisch anonymisiert oder pseudonymisiert. Der Kontext eines ausgewählten Falls kann echte Namen, Beschreibungen, Beträge, Daten und Referenzen enthalten, wenn die fachliche Prüfung sie benötigt.
es: Al principio, el modelo lee un número limitado de filas para reconocer los campos y comprender su significado.
El código procesa localmente todo el alcance
Una vez confirmados los campos y el alcance, el código procesa todos los datos incluidos en el trabajo mediante reglas declaradas y repetibles.
El modelo recibe un índice de los casos que deben revisarse

El índice utiliza referencias opacas a los casos y muestra solo el tipo de caso, el estado y los tipos de señales del control. No contiene nombres, descripciones, importes, fechas, referencias o identificadores presentes en las fuentes ni rutas.
El modelo solicita el contexto de un caso cuando lo necesita

Solo los casos seleccionados aportan los campos mapeados y cumplimentados útiles para la revisión. Quedan fuera los campos vacíos, las columnas no mapeadas, las rutas y los identificadores técnicos; los identificadores profesionales exactos solo se incluyen cuando la comparación los exige.

Los datos profesionales no se anonimizan ni se seudonimizan automáticamente. El contexto de un caso seleccionado puede contener nombres, descripciones, importes, fechas y referencias reales cuando la revisión profesional los necesita.
